label: Lines
help: Lines through the points of each group.

label: Error bars
help: From ymin to ymax, e.g. the summary's lo and hi.

label: Ribbon
help: A band from ymin to ymax.

label: Segments
help: Lines from (x, y) to (xend, yend), e.g. the bars of a swimmer plot.

label: Smoothed line
help: A fitted line and its band.

label: Horizontal lines
help: Reference lines, e.g. y = 0.5 (median), 0, or 20 and -30.

label: Sina plot
help: Points spread by their density, e.g. a distribution per group (instead of box plot + jitter).

label: Error bars (horizontal)
help: From xmin to xmax at a y, e.g. a forest plot's interval.
